title: Care Management
overview: This guide covers care management workflows for Provider.

subtasks.title: Follow Up Query
subtasks.purpose: Build a filtered work-list of patients requiring outreach — missed uploads, out-of-target readings or pending CCM items.

steps.title: Open Follow-Up Query
steps.description: Click Care Mgmt → Follow Up Query in the sidebar.

steps.title: Enter Name Filters
steps.description: Enter Last Name / First Name (partial match).

steps.title: Scope by Provider/Caregiver
steps.description: Optionally scope by Provider and / or Caregiver.

steps.title: Pick Status Filter
steps.description: Optionally pick a Status (Active / Paused / Lost).

steps.title: Run or Reset Query
steps.description: Click Query to load the work-list, or Reset to clear.

steps.title: Keyword-Filter Results
steps.description: Use the Search box to keyword-filter the loaded set.

steps.title: Act on Follow-Up Row
steps.description: Click a row Action to open the patient, log an outreach note or record a follow-up call. Notes The Care Mgmt sidebar sub-menu currently contains only Follow Up; other care-management tools live on the patient profile. Follow-up notes logged here contribute to Service Time on the CCM lookup report. The empty state “Select filters and click Query to load patients” is shown until Query is clicked.
